debugger.title: Debugger
debugger.empty.ready: Press Debug to run until the first enabled breakpoint.
debugger.empty.noEnabled: All breakpoints are disabled. Enable one or use Run.
debugger.status.pausedHint: Execution is stopped at a breakpoint or step. Inspect locals, call stack, and watches before continuing.
debugger.status.readyHint: The debugger is ready. Press Debug to run until the first enabled breakpoint.
debugger.paused.heading: Paused at line {{line}} ({{reason}})
debugger.paused.locals.empty: No variables are available before this line.
debugger.actions.continueHint: Resume execution until the next breakpoint or the program finishes.
debugger.actions.stepOverHint: Run the current line and pause on the next line in this frame.
debugger.actions.stepIntoHint: Enter a local function call when the current line calls one.
debugger.actions.stepOutHint: Finish the current function and pause after it returns.
debugger.actions.stepOut.disabledHint: Step into a function before stepping out.
debugger.actions.detachHint: Continue without stopping at more breakpoints.
debugger.settings.label: Debugger
debugger.settings.hint: Master switch for the JS / TS debugger runtime.
debugger.breakpoints.emptyHint: Add a breakpoint from the editor gutter to enable debugger controls.
debugger.breakpoints.summaryHint: {{enabled}} of {{count}} breakpoints are active in this file. {{global}} total across the workspace.
debugger.breakpoints.tabHint: {{enabled}} of {{count}} breakpoints active in this file.
debugger.breakpoints.clearAll.hint: Remove every breakpoint from every open or saved tab.
debugger.breakpoints.clearAll.confirm: Remove every breakpoint across all files?
debugger.breakpoints.disableAll.hint: Keep breakpoint markers visible but stop pausing on them.
debugger.breakpoints.enableAll.hint: Turn pausing back on for every breakpoint.
debugger.breakpoints.panel.title: Breakpoints
debugger.breakpoints.panel.empty: Add a breakpoint from the editor gutter, then configure it here.
debugger.breakpoints.safeExpressionHint: Expressions inspect a bounded data snapshot. Calls, assignment, constructors, and prototype access are not allowed.
debugger.breakpoints.conditionError: Condition could not be evaluated: {{message}}. Lingua paused instead of silently skipping this line.
debugger.watches.empty: Add an expression to evaluate whenever execution pauses.
debugger.watches.safeExpressionHint: Watch expressions are bounded and read from a detached locals snapshot; they cannot call functions or mutate the running program.
debugger.drawer.collapseHint: Hide debugger details while keeping the bottom panel open.
debugger.drawer.expandHint: Show debugger variables, call stack, watches, and controls.
debugger.breakpoints.nativePauseOnly: Native debuggers use standard pause breakpoints.
debugger.breakpoints.nativeHint: Conditional breakpoints and logpoints remain available for JavaScript and TypeScript; Python, Go, and Rust use pause breakpoints.
debugger.watches.nativeExpressionHint: Native watches run inside the local debug process and may have side effects. Evaluate only expressions you trust.
debugger.hud.label: Debugger controls
